html:
Window tinting is not just for cars! Did you know that we also do boat window tinting? For anyone who spends a lot of time out on the water on their boat, boat tinting is an excellent investment. Below we list the benefits of boat tinting along with our recommendations on the best window tint for boats.

The Australian Maritime Safety Authority states that:

  • Tint used in a navigational window must have a light transmission of at least 70%
  • Tint used in a navigational window must not interfere with recognition of the colour of lights seen through the tinted window

Tint a Car has been supplying Australians with all their tinting needs for almost 50 years. We only ever use high-quality films exclusive to us and Government certified by ARPANSA and all installations are done by professionally trained installers making us Australia’s most trusted tinting network. We offer zero-interest payment plans and offer peace of mind Lifetime Warranties on most of our films, including boat tinting films. If you have a boat, here is why we recommend boat tinting, what the best window tint for boats is and how to get boat window tint costs

The Benefits Of Boat Tinting

One of the biggest benefits of boat tinting is having harmful UV rays blocked which is essential for anyone who spends a lot of time out on the water and in the sun. In addition to protecting you and your passengers, this also helps to protect your boat’s interior too. Other reasons why boat tinting is a wise choice include:

  • Boat tinting significantly reduces glare
  • Boat window tint rejects heat keeping your boat cabin at a much more comfortable temperature (if you head out in the cooler months, boat window tint also helps to retain heat too – more comfortable cabin temperatures all year round!)
  • Boating tint adds a protective layer to your boat’s windows making them more durable and less susceptible to breakages

What Is The Best Window Tint For Boats?

There are a few different options when it comes to boat tinting films so it will depend on your preference. However, our recommendation when it comes to the best window tint for boats is our Spectre film featuring innovative ceramic technology.

Spectre offers superior infrared heat rejection, it has the highest infrared heat rejection compared to any of our other films. It blocks up to 91% of infrared heat and almost completely blocks out UV rays. It is fade-resistant and long-lasting so is ideal for boat tinting. Spectre also gives you clear, uninterrupted viewing through your boat’s windows, both day and night.

One of the main factors that make Spectre the best window tint for boats is that it is designed specifically so there is zero interference with signals from electronic devices such as mobile phones, satellite navigation, FM, AM and digital radio station reception or tablets.

Spectre boat tinting film comes in multiple shades, is exclusive to us and we offer a nationwide lifetime warranty on all Spectre applications. Another recommendation from our range is Black Panther which also offers superior heat rejection, clarity, protection and durability. Black Panther has also been designed so it doesn’t interfere with technology.
